d: "Tyohar Asharfi" is a gold-coin-inspired luxury sweet launched by the Tyohar Outlet in Jaipur, Rajasthan, which costs approximately ₹1.23 lakh per kilogram. Designed specifically as an extravagant festive gifting option, a single 9-gram piece is priced at ₹1,111, while a curated gift box containing nine pieces retails for ₹9,999.
